entities.name: Lily
entities.description: Wizard from Dominaria using blue and white magic; wife of Gull and mother of two daughters.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Husband of Lily who leads an army against evil wizards.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: Power-hungry wizard who hired Lily and was later defeated.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Gull's sister whose powers Towser schemed to steal.

entities.name: Hyacinth
entities.description: Daughter of Lily and Gull, born around 4075.

entities.name: Sweet
entities.description: Daughter of Lily and Gull, named after Bittersweet.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: Village destroyed before Gull joined Towser's caravan.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Battle Lily and her family survived.

entities.name: Dingus Egg
entities.description: Item that helped Lily learn to teleport.

events.summary: Towser hires Lily in 4072 AR, truly because she showed magical potential.
events.quote: he hired her because she showed magical potential

events.summary: Gull falls in love with Lily after joining Towser's caravan.
events.quote: Gull fell in love with Lily

events.summary: Towser kidnaps the girls and teleports Gull away; Lily summons him back and Towser is defeated.
events.quote: Lily discovered her magical ability to summon Gull back.

events.summary: Lily teleports a team to Benalia City to rescue Norreen.
events.quote: She used this ability to bring a team to Benalia City to rescue Norreen from imprisonment and torture.

events.summary: Lily and Gull marry and have two daughters.
events.quote: Lily and Gull found their way back to each other after the rescue in Benalia and were married.

events.summary: Lily is present at but does not take part in the Battle of Lat-Nam, which her family survives.
events.quote: She was present for, but did not participate in, the Battle of Lat-Nam

relations.quote: She was the wife of Gull and had two children with him.
Together, they had two daughters - Hyacinth around 4075
